exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Solana (SOL) traded at $79.9100 as of 2026-11-13 06:41:56 UTC, +0.35% over one hour and -3.49% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $78.1000 to $83.3600; spot sits at 34% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -12.08% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($81.4204) is below the 72-hour average ($82.9857). Spot is 12.07% below the seven-day high of $90.8797 and 2.32% above the seven-day low of $78.1000.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 2.99% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 36.4, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $3.03 billion, equal to 6.41% of the $47.27 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 20 ("Extreme Fear"), versus 28 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink SOL/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $78.8212, 3.3 hours before the spot quote and -1.36% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price at $79.91 sits near the lower bound of the 24‑hour range ($78.10‑$83.36) and only 34% up the range, indicating a cushion for upside re‑acceleration as buyers test the $83.36 ceiling [Ex. B, A].  

2. Realized volatility is modest at 2.99% per day, and the RSI of 36.4 signals that bearish pressure is easing, creating a favorable risk‑reward profile for a long entry [Ex. D].  

3. Liquidity is robust with $3.03 B traded in 24 h (6.41% of market cap) and fear dominates the sentiment index at 20, suggesting a contrarian long bias as risk appetite improves [Ex. E, F]; the Chainlink feed at $78.8212 provides a reliable settlement level slightly below spot, enhancing upside potential [Ex. G].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price of SOL is trading at $79.91, well below the 24‑hour range midpoint and 34% into the range, indicating a price floor near the lower bound and a high probability of a short‑term rebound to the range’s upper half [Ex. A, B].  

2. Momentum metrics confirm bearish pressure: a 7‑day decline of 12.08% with the 24‑hour average under the 72‑hour average, a low RSI of 36.4, and realized volatility of only 2.99% per day, suggesting limited upside volatility and a continuation of the downtrend [Ex. C, D].  

3. Market sentiment is in “Extreme Fear” (CFGI 20), a classic contrarian signal for short positions, while liquidity is ample ($3.03 B) to support execution without slippage, and the Chainlink feed—our settlement price—lies $78.82, reinforcing the lower‑bound bias [Ex. E, F, G].  

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s first claim rests on a misreading of the 24‑hour range: the spot sits at 34 % of the range, not near the lower bound; the price is still $1.72 above the 24‑hour low, leaving ample room for upside before any “floor” is tested [Ex. B]. Secondly, the Bear touts “Extreme Fear” as a contrarian short signal, yet the Fear & Greed Index has risen from 20 to 28 over the past week, indicating easing anxiety and a potential reversal of sentiment, not a sustained bearish tide [Ex. F]. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s first point rests on a mis‑reading of the range: spot sits at only 34 % of the 24‑hour span, but the price is already 12.07 % below the seven‑day high and the 24‑hour average ($81.42) remains beneath the 72‑hour average ($82.99), showing persistent downward pressure [Ex. C]. The second point ignores that the RSI of 36.4, while technically neutral, is still below the 40‑threshold many traders use as a bearish signal, indicating momentum remains weak, not easing [Ex. D]. Thus the purported upside cushion and risk‑reward improvement are illusory. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds the evidence supports a short practice position for SOL/USD.

findings.finding: Spot price $79.91 is near the lower bound of its 24‑hour range
Seven‑day trend is –12.08% and 24‑hour average remains below the 72‑hour average
Crypto Fear & Greed Index at 20 indicates extreme fear

ruling.opinion: The price sits low in its daily range and continues a steep seven‑day decline, showing bearish momentum despite modest volatility [Ex. A, C, D]. Extreme fear further signals downside pressure, and the Chainlink settlement price is below spot, limiting upside potential [Ex. G]. Together these factors point to a higher probability of further decline over the next 24 hours, justifying a short practice position.
ruling.dissent: Bull argues the RSI and modest volatility suggest easing pressure, but the dominant downtrend and extreme fear outweigh those neutral signals.
